title: Tiny, Always-on and Fragile: Bias Propagation through Design Choices in On-device Machine Learning Workflows
reasoning: The paper investigates reliability bias and performance disparities (fairness) within the context of on-device machine learning for keyword spotting. While fairness is an ethical concern in AI, the study focuses on technical and statistical metrics of model performance rather than evaluating or benchmarking religious beliefs, faith traditions, or moral/ethical philosophies as a primary subject. Additionally, it does not involve Large Language Models (LLMs).
